heading: Breaking News
text: Five current Broward County School Board members endorse the reelection of their colleague, Dr. Allen Zeman.

heading: Mayor
text: “I, Jeff Holness, endorse Dr. Allen Zeman, for re-election to Broward County School Board, At Large, Seat 8. As a well-regarded economist and successful owner of a data analytics company, Dr. Zeman brings a wealth of unique skills, knowledge, and experience that add value and substance to Board discussion. Dr. Zeman’s energy, passion, and commitment to the Board’s common goal of creating a top rated school district is evident at every meeting. He also understands the issues facing parents and students, having his own children attending Broward Public Schools. Please join me in supporting Dr. Allen Zeman for re-election to Broward County School Board At Large Seat 8!

heading: Mayor
text: Vice Chair of Broward County School Board:

heading: Commissioner Fitz Budhoo
text: I am committed to ethical behavior and transparent decision making, something that is needed as much now as it was in 2011. We have to restore trust and faith in our elected Broward County school leaders.
